title: DonutSMP Media GUI
body:
MediaRank / MediaSystem is a Paper 1.21.11 plugin that introduces a fully interactive media creator rank system for your server. Players can use /media to open a clean GUI that displays all requirements needed to achieve the “Media Rank”, including YouTube views, TikTok followers, Instagram followers, Twitch average viewers, and general content creation activity.

The GUI is designed as a 27-slot chest menu with a dedicated “Media Requirements” item that clearly explains how players can qualify for the rank in a visually simple and organized format.

For server staff, the plugin includes an OP-only command /mediarankgear, which grants a balanced diamond gear set themed for content creators. This includes armor and tools with light enchantments and custom names such as “Media Sword” and “Media Helmet”, making it feel like a special reward without being overpowered.

The plugin also features sound effects, cooldown protection, and configurable messages to ensure a smooth and polished experience. Built for performance and ease of use, MediaSystem is perfect for SMPs and servers that want to reward content creators and encourage player engagement.
